source_lineage.concept: Evaluate one isolated research change through a reversible champion-challenger process.

hypothesis.claim: A lagged relative-strength filter may reduce entries during persistent sector weakness.
hypothesis.causal_mechanism: Sector-relative momentum may proxy for information diffusion and avoid fighting broad institutional flows.
hypothesis.expected_failure_mode: The filter may enter late, increase turnover, and underperform during sharp mean-reversion regimes.

single_change.proposed_diff: Add one lagged sector-relative momentum term; do not change any other feature or threshold.

inputs.name: lagged_relative_return_20d
inputs.definition: Twenty-session total return minus the canonical sector ETF total return, both ending before decision time.
inputs.availability_lag: Use only prices available at the prior official close; no same-session close leakage.
inputs.source: Point-in-time split- and dividend-adjusted prices from the approved research dataset.

exclusions: Exclude records lacking point-in-time sector membership or complete corporate-action history.
signal.horizon: Evaluate forward excess return over five and twenty trading sessions.
signal.rebalance: Recompute once per official market session after the close.
signal.execution_lag: Earliest simulated execution is the next tradable session with explicit spread and impact costs.

data.corporate_action_policy: UNKNOWN until splits, dividends, delistings, symbol changes, and membership changes are specified.

evaluation.benchmark: SPY total return plus the unchanged baseline model
evaluation.primary_metric: Draft primary metric: out-of-sample information ratio of net excess returns.
evaluation.minimum_effect: UNKNOWN until a practically meaningful effect and confidence threshold are set before testing.
evaluation.cost_model: Include commissions, bid-ask spread, market impact, delayed or failed fills, and taxes when applicable.
evaluation.turnover_limit: UNKNOWN until the baseline turnover and realistic capacity are measured.
evaluation.capacity_assumption: UNKNOWN until ADV, participation rate, and position-size constraints are measured.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Draft a dependence-aware bootstrap confidence interval method before any testing begins.
evaluation.multiple_testing_family: Count this candidate with every related feature, horizon, threshold, and regime tried in the same research family.
evaluation.dependence_control: Purge overlapping labels, embargo adjacent folds, and avoid treating overlapping horizons as independent samples.
evaluation.parameter_sensitivity: Evaluate a pre-declared beta grid and neighboring lookbacks without selecting a single lucky peak.

shadow_plan.acceptance_rule: UNKNOWN until the test metric, sample floor, and operational failure budget are frozen.

rollback.trigger: Reject on data leakage, schema drift, material cost-model miss, or failure of the frozen reviewed acceptance rule.
rollback.maximum_drawdown: UNKNOWN until a shadow drawdown budget is approved by the human operator.
rollback.data_quality_trigger: Reject if point-in-time integrity, symbol history, or corporate-action coverage cannot be demonstrated.
